review_items.decision: Accept overlay ID rlp.trace-mode/kv-offload-v1alpha1, every exact dependency digest, and preservation of the frozen P0 bytes.

Accept the single kv_cache_mode=local_offload value only for one-host TP=PP=DP=1 tiering_enabled runtime-core OffloadingConnector/TieringOffloadingSpec, excluding tiering_disabled CPUOffloadingSpec and all NPU specs.

Accept the exact root binding metadata and require a later joint admission record binding the approved overlay, issue2 mapping and approval record, complete configuration and approval record, profile and owner record, and frozen P0 records, co-signed by the P0 owner and issue-134 configuration authority.

Accept the closed H2D-only base-operation roster: zero or one H2D pair per lifecycle, exactly three edges for a positive episode, and zero base spans/edges for D2H and transfer_wait; require at least one positive lifecycle in a formal state-machine run.
Accept the exact cross-epoch preempted-to-H2D-to-next-admission bridge and its bounded transfer_id pending-context requirement.
Accept the deterministic existing-P0 unsupported-reason mapping, unchanged validation/loss/receipt rules, serving fail-open behavior, and formal-evidence fail-closed behavior.
Accept that issue2 mapping approval, complete configuration approval, CPU/G1 checks, and later hardware gates remain independent and cannot be substituted by this overlay approval.
Accept content-addressed immutability and that this approval does not authorize communication-mode activation, G1, source edits, NPU, service launch, an experiment, a performance claim, or M0.
